values.meaning: Duration of the curse mark before it is automatically expunged (recast)
values.quote: marks them with a curse for {{fd|3.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Twofold Hex can be recast after 0.1 seconds while at least one target is marked, and automatically recasts at the end of the mark's duration if not recast manually.
mechanics.quote: ''Twofold Hex'' can be recast after {{fd|0.1}} seconds while at least one target is marked, and does so automatically at the end of the mark's duration.

mechanics.claim: The recast fires bolts that deal magic damage to every enemy they pass through, scaled up by each target's missing health, and hitting the same target again on the same recast deals only 20% damage.
mechanics.quote: Subsequent bolts against an enemy deal {{ap|{{#var:boltmod}}*100}}% damage.

mechanics.claim: Once Aurora has successfully recast Twofold Hex, she cannot recast it again for the remainder of that mark's duration regardless of remaining marked enemies.
mechanics.quote: Once '''Aurora''' has successfully recast ''Twofold Hex'', she will not be able to recast it again for the duration regardless of any number of marked enemies still remaining.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield can block the effects of both the outbound cast and the recast.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} can block the effects of the active and the recast.
